title: Recall lacks admitted identity and route, outlives its primary turn/issuer and accepts failed selector output
cause: Pre-step precedes Gateway message admission, so its old routed model and ambient participant state do not identify the admitted question. The independent selector controller misses primary cancellation until turn/end. Entry reads and valid JSON from failed/aborted responses can publish without current issuer or successful completion.
implementation: Stage the question/catalog in pre-step and start from admitted agent/request configuration. Capture and retain the original authority and participants, pass explicit verified billing witnesses, link primary cancellation, recheck execute permission at dispatch/publication and compare the issuer after async work. Read recall never requires memory-writing qualification. Failed or aborted terminal outcomes cannot inject. Preserve owned cleanup and dispose the asynchronous context after all selectors settle.
